axis_values.inside: the scenario sets a range (or a gravity level) and every value of it lies inside what the card states
axis_values.outside: the scenario's range is not contained in what the card states (overlap 'partial' or 'none' is given); the card's verbatim words are shown
axis_values.card_unstated: the card's items state nothing on this axis
axis_values.scenario_unstated: the card states the axis and the scenario sets no range or level for it

_meta.containment_rule: A range of the scenario is inside a range of the card only if both of its ends lie inside, with the inclusive flags (scenario ranges: a minimum is included and a maximum is not unless the scenario says otherwise; an open end lies inside only an open end). A card that states single values (points) contains no scenario range, because no scenario range is a single value. Gravity is inside if the scenario's level is one of the card's levels.
overall: the card is not in our references
at least one compared axis is outside
no compared axis is outside and gravity is inside
_meta.overall_note: may_be_quoted_here says only that no range stated by the card excludes the scenario. Axes that the card does not state do not block it and are named in the sentence. It is not a judgement of the condition.
_meta.range_notation: [a, b] includes both ends, (a, b) neither; -inf or +inf marks an end the range does not set.
